title: Granite Ridge Season Pass Schedule: Age Bands, Identity Requirements and Standing Entitlements at Sale
content:
Five figures are published per tier of the Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme for who may hold the pass and what must be on file: whether a pass protection plan may be attached to the tier, the age bands the tier is sold in, whether documentary proof of age must be on file before activation, whether a passholder photograph must be on file before activation, and whether holding the pass to the end of the season locks the same price for the following season.

| Tier | Protection plan may be attached | Age bands sold | Proof of age required | Photograph required | Next season price lock |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | no | child, youth, teen, adult, senior, super senior | no | no | no |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | yes | youth, teen, adult, senior, super senior | yes | yes | no |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | yes | child, youth, teen, adult, senior, super senior | yes | yes | yes |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | yes | child, youth, teen, adult, senior, super senior | yes | yes | yes |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | yes | child, youth, teen, adult, senior, super senior | yes | yes | yes |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | yes | child, youth, teen, adult, senior, super senior | yes | yes | yes |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | yes | adult, senior, super senior | yes | yes | yes |

Two tiers are sold in fewer than all six bands: the Granite Ridge Midweek Pass is not sold in the child band, and the Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass is sold only in the adult, senior and super senior bands.

The Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass is the one tier of the programme that carries none of the four remaining entries: no protection plan may be attached to it, no proof of age or photograph is required before it is activated, and it carries no price lock for the following season.

### Entry conditions published per tier

| Tier | Minimum age (years) | Pass held in the preceding season required | Household account required | Proof of residency required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | 5 | no | no | no |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | 5 | no | no | no |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | 5 | no | no | yes |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | 5 | no | no | no |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | 5 | no | no | no |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | 5 | no | no | no |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | 16 | yes | yes | no |
